categories.name: Admission NC
categories.description: Patient is admitted to a non-critical inpatient ward (Admission NC). This advances the goal of patient admission while interacting with softgoals, though Admission IC specifically carries a negative contribution to minimizing time-to-treatment.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative Admission NC (id=15) from the OR decomposition of goal id=5. Supported by frequent and rare variants such as V0008, V0625, and V0068 where Admission NC is observed.

categories.name: Admission IC
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an intensive care unit (Admission IC). This alternative carries a SomeNegative (-25) contribution effect to the softgoal 'Minimize time-to-treatment'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative Admission IC (id=16) from the OR decomposition of goal id=5. Supported by narrative samples such as V0605, V0317, and V0068 which realize intensive care unit admission.
